name_en: Azara — aged napa pickles simmered with rockfish and sake lees
summary_ja: 長く漬け込んで酸味の増した白菜の古漬けと、メヌケのあらを酒粕でじっくり煮込む気仙沼の料理。冷めても、翌日煮返してもうまみが増すと伝わる、庶民に親しまれてきた一皿。
summary_en: Napa cabbage pickled long enough to turn sour is simmered slowly with rockfish trimmings and sake lees — a Kesennuma dish said to taste even better cold, or reheated the next day, long loved as everyday food.
source_title: あざら 宮城県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
